sections.heading: Processing time
body: Orders are picked and packed within 2–4 business days of payment clearing. Orders placed at a weekend or on a public holiday start processing the next business day.
You'll get a confirmation when your order is placed, and a second message with tracking once it ships.

sections.heading: Delivery options and cost
body: Standard shipping is free and takes 5–8 business days after dispatch.
Express shipping costs $12.00 and takes 2–3 business days after dispatch.
Delivery estimates are for transit time after dispatch and don't include the processing time above.

sections.heading: Where we ship
body: We ship to every destination you can select at checkout. If your country isn't listed, we can't currently deliver there.
Import duties and taxes for international orders are set by your country and are the recipient's responsibility. We can't calculate or pre-pay them.

sections.heading: Delays and lost parcels
body: Once a parcel is with the carrier, its progress is out of our hands. If tracking hasn't moved for 10 business days, email us and we'll open an investigation with the carrier.
If an order is confirmed lost in transit, we'll replace it or refund it in full — your choice.

sections.heading: Wrong address
body: We ship to the address entered at checkout. Email us as soon as possible if you spot a mistake — we can change it before dispatch, but not after.
Parcels returned to us because of an incorrect or incomplete address can be reshipped once you cover the postage.

sections.heading: Your right to return
body: You can return anything within 30 days of delivery for a refund, for any reason.
Items must be unused, in the condition you received them, and in their original packaging. A jacket that's been worn in water can't be resold, so we can't accept it back unless it's faulty.

sections.heading: How to start a return
body: Email {email} with your order number and what you'd like to return. We'll reply with return instructions.
Please don't send anything back before contacting us — returns without instructions can't be tracked to your order, and we may not be able to refund them.

sections.heading: Who pays return postage
body: We cover it. Returns and exchanges are free within 30 days — email us and we'll send you a prepaid label.
We recommend using the label we send rather than your own service, so the parcel can be tracked back to your order.

sections.heading: When you get your money
body: We inspect returns on arrival and issue the refund within 10 business days.
Refunds go back to the card or wallet you paid with — we can't send them anywhere else. Your bank may take a few more days to show it.

sections.heading: Faulty items
body: If something arrives damaged or develops a fault, email us with a photo and your order number. We'll replace it or refund it, including postage both ways.
This sits alongside your statutory rights, which nothing in this policy limits.

sections.heading: Cancelling an order
body: Email us as soon as you can. If the order hasn't been dispatched we'll cancel and refund it in full. After dispatch, treat it as a return.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: To fulfil an order we collect your name, email address, delivery address, and phone number if you give one. We keep a record of what you bought and when.
We also collect basic technical information — IP address, browser type, pages viewed — which is normal for any website and helps us keep the shop working.

sections.heading: Payment details
body: We never see or store your card number. Payments are processed by Stripe on their own hosted page; we receive only the fact that a payment succeeded, the amount, and the last-four digits Stripe shows us.
Stripe's handling of your data is governed by their privacy policy at stripe.com/privacy.

sections.heading: Advertising and analytics
body: We use the Meta pixel and Meta's Conversions API to measure which adverts lead to sales. This means some information about your visit and purchase is shared with Meta, including a hashed (irreversibly scrambled) version of your email address and delivery details, so Meta can match it to an account without us handing over the raw values.
You can limit this in your Facebook and Instagram ad settings, and by using your browser's tracking protection or an ad blocker.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: We use a cookie to remember your language choice and your basket, and Meta sets cookies for advertising measurement as described above.
Blocking cookies in your browser will stop the advertising ones. The basket and language cookies are needed for the shop to work.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: Order records are kept for as long as we need them for accounting and tax purposes, which is typically several years.
If you ask us to delete your data we'll do so except where we're legally required to keep a record of a sale.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You can ask for a copy of the data we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email {email} and we'll respond as quickly as we can.
If you're in the UK or EU you also have the right to complain to your national data protection authority.

sections.heading: Who we share with
body: Only the parties needed to run the shop: Stripe for payment, our shipping carrier for delivery, and Meta for advertising measurement as described above. We don't sell your data.

sections.heading: Prices and currency
body: All prices are in US dollars and include no taxes unless stated at checkout. The price you see at checkout is the price you pay.
We can change prices at any time, but never after you've placed an order.

sections.heading: Orders
body: An order is an offer to buy. It's accepted when we dispatch it, and we may decline it — for example if an item turns out to be out of stock or we spot a pricing error. If we decline, we refund you in full.
Product photographs are representative. Colours can vary between screens.

sections.heading: Using a dog life jacket safely
body: A dog life jacket is a buoyancy aid, not a lifesaving device, and it is not a substitute for supervision. Never leave a dog unattended in or near water, even wearing one.
Check the fit before every use and inspect the jacket, straps and buckles for wear. Stop using it if anything is damaged.
Choose the size from the size chart using your dog's measurements, not their breed or weight alone.

sections.heading: Liability
body: We're responsible for loss you suffer as a foreseeable result of us breaking these terms or failing to use reasonable care. We're not responsible for losses we couldn't have foreseen.
Nothing here limits liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for fraud, or anything else that can't be limited by law.

sections.heading: Contact
body: ChillMyPet, contactable at {email}. Get in touch with any question about an order or these terms.
